{{< include /knowledge/includes/setup-parameters.qmd >}}

One of the most effective tactics your species invented is the coordinated annual action day. Earth Day turned environmentalism into a movement. Giving Tuesday moved $3 billion per year into nonprofits. World AIDS Day kept HIV funding alive for decades. Hour Earth got a billion humans to turn off their lights at the same time, which did approximately nothing ecologically but demonstrated that coordinated global behavior is physically possible.

Earth Optimization Day is one of those days. Annual. Global. Same date every year. Every partner, every embed, every ad campaign, every public post launches on the same day. And on that day, the treaty percentage ratchets up by another percent. Year 1: 1%. Year 2: 2%. Year 5: 10%. The day is not just an advocacy anniversary. It is the built-in escalation mechanism for reducing war and accelerating disease eradication at the same time.

The name describes the day exactly. Every year, humanity gets one percent less irrational than it was the year before.

## What the Day Is

Two things happen on Earth Optimization Day.

**The vote count gets its annual pulse.** Every partner org, every embed, every ad campaign, every influencer, every podcast, every meme, every press cycle fires on the same day. One coordinated global push. Partners that spent the year warm up for this launch. A journalist writing about "a campaign to redirect 1% of military spending" has to explain the campaign, the math, and the mechanism from scratch. A journalist writing about "today, five hundred nonprofits simultaneously launched voting widgets" has a story with a date, a fact, and a lede.

**The treaty ratchets up.** Article III of the [1% Treaty](/knowledge/solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@1-percent-treaty-paper-2025] [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025] says the percentage only goes up, never down. Earth Optimization Day is when it moves. Year 1 is the proof of concept at 1%. Year 2 moves to 2%, conditional on the previous year's visible success. Year 5 moves to 10%. The bondholders and Super PAC whose returns scale with the percentage have a permanent financial incentive to make each year's ratchet happen, which is the whole point of the [Incentive Alignment Bond](/knowledge/solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) structure.

The day is both the annual advocacy anchor and the actual mechanism by which the redirect grows.

## Why a Day Works

Coordinated days produce four compounding effects.

1. **Pre-commitment deadlines for partners.** An org that has been stalling on embedding now has a reason to ship before the date.
2. **Media hooks.** The event itself is the story. Launch days get picked up by outlets that ignore ongoing advocacy.
3. **Social-proof cascades.** When a partner sees fifty peer orgs committing to the date, they join. The threshold for joining a coordinated wave is lower than the threshold for starting one.
4. **Viral compounding.** Simultaneous launches amplify each other. Five posts scattered across a month is five posts. Five hundred posts on the same hour is a trending topic.

The ratchet adds a fifth compounding effect that normal action days do not have.

5. **Built-in escalation.** Other coordinated days rely on year-over-year enthusiasm to grow. Earth Optimization Day grows the redirect percentage mechanically. The day's impact compounds because the underlying allocation compounds.

## Precedents

Earth Day (1970) created the modern environmental movement out of essentially nothing. Before Earth Day, "environment" was not a standalone political concept. After Earth Day, every major environmental law of the 1970s passed. Clean Air Act. Clean Water Act. EPA. One day did not pass the laws, but one day changed the framing that made the laws possible.

Giving Tuesday (2012) manufactured an industry calendar event. Nonprofits organize around it. Platforms promote it. Last cycle moved about $3 billion on one day. The infrastructure for Giving Tuesday did not exist in 2011. It was built.

World AIDS Day (1988) is the reason HIV funding survived as a budget category across four decades. Before the coordinated day, HIV was an issue. After the day, it was a cause with infrastructure, budget lines, and annual political pressure.

None of these days required new facts. They required picking a date and making it the one day everyone coordinated. Earth Optimization Day adds a sixth: picking a date and making it the one day the law ratchets up.

## The Date

August 6 is Hiroshima Day, the date the first atomic weapon was used on humans. It has an existing cultural gravity that would be expensive to manufacture.

It fits the day's mission exactly. Earth Optimization Day is about redirecting the military budget (the war half of the redirect) and funding clinical trials (the disease half). Those two moves are the two halves of the same treaty. August 6 marks the moment when humanity built the capacity to annihilate itself; Earth Optimization Day marks the annual moment when humanity takes a percent of that capacity and points it at cures instead.

The anti-nuclear and peace-movement communities are the natural primary audience, not a risk. ICAN, the Federation of American Scientists, FCNL, Beyond the Bomb, and Ploughshares have spent decades asking for exactly the military-budget reduction this day celebrates. Earth Optimization Day is the operational successor to "never again." Their grief about Hiroshima becomes the emotional foundation for the mechanism that redirects the military budgets that built it. That is alignment, not co-optation.

Pitch to three or five major peace orgs before locking the date publicly. If any see it differently, adjust. But the base expectation is endorsement.

**Alternatives if August 6 gets pushback:**

- **April 7.** World Health Day. Existing health infrastructure, plausible framing.
- **October 24.** UN Day. Appropriate for a global coordination ask.
- **A fresh date with no prior baggage.** Pick one, own the narrative, let gravity accumulate over years.

Earth Optimization Day's existence matters more than Earth Optimization Day's date.

## Mechanics

The day is not a one-time push. It is a simultaneous launch of everything the movement has been building up to.

### Leading up to the day

- Partner orgs sign up to participate publicly, months in advance. The public list of committed partners becomes its own recruiting tool.
- Each partner receives a pre-made launch package: embed code, social posts, email templates, ad creatives, press release.
- The prize pool announces a matching bonus for voters acquired on the day.
- Named assignees on the [Humanity To-Do List](/knowledge/strategy/humanity-todo-list.qmd) receive a pre-day reminder that their death counters are about to become the week's public anchor.
- The ratchet bill (the one-paragraph legal instrument moving the treaty from N% to N+1%) is submitted to every signatory government in the weeks prior.

### The day itself

- Every committed partner publishes their embed page at 00:00 UTC.
- Every committed partner posts their pre-made social content at staggered intervals across their timezones.
- Every participating ad campaign activates.
- Every participating influencer posts their prepared content.
- The vote count page displays a real-time global ticker of votes cast that day.
- Signatory governments that pass the ratchet publish the news on the same day. The ones that delay become named entries on the to-do list by end of day.
- Major media receive advance briefings and embargoed access to the day-of data.

### The days after

- Partners publish their day-of stats in their own communications.
- The total vote count becomes the anchor for the next media cycle.
- Named to-do-list assignees who acted on the day get their counters frozen publicly. Named assignees who did not act get profile features describing their position.
- Attribution data feeds the next round of grant applications.

## How to Get Everyone to Show Up

Partner commitments are the backbone. But most people on the day are individuals, not orgs. Every individual who posts, calls, and votes on Earth Optimization Day has to get there on purpose. That requires infrastructure that most campaigns skip because it is unglamorous and effective.

### Calendar Mechanics

- **One-click add-to-calendar widget on the voting site.** Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, and .ics file download. A person who clicks it now has Earth Optimization Day on their calendar and will get their OS-native reminder on the day.
- **Recurring annual event.** The calendar entry should be recurring, not a one-off. Every year by default.
- **Calendar invite attached to the "thanks for voting" confirmation page.** Every new voter gets the add-to-calendar button on their confirmation screen. Highest-intent moment; highest conversion on the calendar commitment.

### Pledge Wall

- **Public pledge wall** on the site: "I will post, call, and vote on Earth Optimization Day." Every name visible. Count visible. Filterable by country, organization, profession.
- **Per-country, per-state, per-city counters.** People commit to not being the laggard in their geography.
- **Social sharing on pledge.** One-click post to X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook, Instagram: "I just pledged to participate in Earth Optimization Day on August 6. [link]"
- **Reminder emails tied to pledge status.** People who pledge get a different (more aggressive) reminder cadence than people who did not.

### Email Signature Promotion

- **Email signature block** on the site that people can copy-paste: "Earth Optimization Day is August 6. [Add to calendar] [Pledge to participate]."
- **Gmail / Outlook signature templates.** One-click install for the major clients.
- **Auto-refreshing version.** Signature block updates dynamically as the day approaches: "Earth Optimization Day is in 47 days" → "Earth Optimization Day is TOMORROW" → "Earth Optimization Day is TODAY. Post the vote link."

### Profile Assets

- **Social media profile banners** for X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram. One design per platform, downloadable at pledge time.
- **Twibbon-style profile photo overlays.** A small badge that adds to existing profile pictures, rather than replacing them. Lower friction, higher adoption.
- **"Earth Optimization Day 2026" year-dated versions.** Annual rotation means last year's badge becomes visible proof of prior-year participation.

### Reminder Cadence

For everyone who pledged or subscribed, the site triggers reminders on a specific schedule:

- **T-30 days.** Email: "Earth Optimization Day is in a month. Here's your launch package."
- **T-14 days.** Email: "Two weeks. Here's a draft post for your platforms."
- **T-7 days.** Email: "One week. Here's the call schedule if you want to participate in the live wave."
- **T-1 day.** Email + optional SMS: "Tomorrow at 00:00 UTC. Here is your kit."
- **Day 0, 00:00 UTC.** Email + optional SMS + push notification: "Today. Post. Call. Vote. Go."
- **Day 0, every 4 hours.** Push notification to participants: "Live vote count: X. You are contributing to a thing that is visibly working."
- **Day +1.** Email: "Here is what happened. Here is your attribution receipt. Here is how to sign up for next year."

### Live Day-Of Infrastructure

- **Live vote ticker on the site**, updated every second. People refresh to watch the number climb.
- **Live leaderboard by country, region, and partner org.** FOMO is load-bearing. Orgs at the bottom of the leaderboard see their rank; their boards see their rank; their staff see their rank.
- **Hourly milestones announced.** "100,000 votes in 3 hours. Next target: one million by end of day." Creates narrative beats for media to pick up.
- **Live-updating "attributable lives saved today" counter.** Math from the book's parameter system, multiplied by votes-acquired-today. Tangible proof of the day's impact.
- **Livestream or live podcast.** One continuous stream running all day. Interviews, updates, partner announcements, policy commentary. Gives the day a broadcast center and a place for people to hang out.

### Financial Incentive: The Prize Pool Bonus

- **Matching multiplier on the day.** Votes acquired on Earth Optimization Day count double (or triple) toward the prize pool attribution. Referrers get a bigger share of the eventual payout for voters they brought in on the day vs. other days.
- **Published in advance.** Announced at T-30 so people organize their outreach around the day.

### The Hashtag

Pick one. Enforce its use in every partner package, every reminder email, every post template. Predicted candidates: `#EarthOptimizationDay`, `#OnePercentLessIrrational`, `#August6`. Test the shortlist with one or two partners before locking it.

### Coordinated Content Beats

The distribution-checklist chapter lists perennial content. For the day specifically, add a few day-of-only moves:

- **Pre-recorded video messages from named supporters** that release simultaneously at 00:00 UTC in each supporter's timezone.
- **"One post per hour for 24 hours" schedule** for the highest-reach accounts that pledge to participate.
- **Live Q&A slots** with the coordinator, scientists, economists, and policymakers running across the day.
- **End-of-day thank-you post** to all participants, embedding the final vote count as a public number.

## The Ratchet

Year over year, the percentage grows. The bondholders profit in proportion to the treaty fund size, so every bondholder becomes a lobbyist for the next ratchet. The Political Incentive Fund scales the same way, so every politician who passed last year's ratchet gets proportionally more campaign support before this year's ratchet.

The mechanism runs on its own alignment. The bondholders want the percentage higher. The politicians want it higher. The health ministers want it higher. Even the defense contractors retained {{< var defense_sector_retention_pct >}} of their original budget and earn returns on the redirected portion, so their total compensation rises. Nobody inside the system wants the number to stay flat. This is the first time in your species' history that the incentive structure pulls in the right direction without requiring anyone to become a better person.

If the ratchet is not voted in on a given year, the day still happens. The vote count still pulses. The to-do list still names the holdouts. The ratchet bill stays on the table for the next year. Nothing is lost. The day is permanent.

## Partner Commitment Cycle

Year 1 outreach starts a hundred and twenty days before the day.

- **Day -120.** First wave of partner pitches. Target the fifty largest relevant nonprofits and foundations.
- **Day -90.** First wave of confirmed partners listed publicly. Second wave of pitches uses the first wave as social proof.
- **Day -60.** Launch packages go to all confirmed partners. Second wave of pitches closes.
- **Day -30.** Third and final wave. Final list of committed partners published.
- **Day -14.** Launch-week dress rehearsal. Partners test embeds. Ad campaigns load.
- **Day -1.** Press packages release. Embargoed media briefings happen.
- **Day 0.** Launch.
- **Day +14.** Year 1 data package published. Year 2 partner outreach begins. Ratchet bill reviewed for Year 2.

## Year-Over-Year Progression

Year 1 is small. Maybe five to twenty partners. A few hundred thousand voters acquired on the day, if everything goes well. Redirect holds at 1%. The value of Year 1 is not the numbers. It is the precedent. That the day happens. That coordinated global action is demonstrably possible. That a public list of partners exists to recruit from for Year 2. That the first ratchet mechanism is operational.

Year 2 uses Year 1's data as the case. Redirect ratchets to 2%. Funders who ignored Year 1 pitches fund Year 2. Partners who watched from the sidelines commit to Year 2. Media coverage of Year 1 generates inbound interest.

Year 3 hits a different order of magnitude. Redirect ratchets to 3%. By the time the day is "a thing every relevant org participates in," the vote count and the ratchet schedule combine into a number that governments have to engage with.

Year 5, at a 10% redirect, the military-industrial complex has lost a tenth of its revenue to cures and peace. The defense sector still retains {{< var defense_sector_retention_pct >}} of their pre-treaty budget and earns Victory Bond returns on the redirected portion, so their total compensation rises. Nobody on the political-economic inside is worse off. Humanity is one tenth less irrational.

## Integration With Everything Else

- The [ninety-day operator plan](getting-started.qmd) treats the first Earth Optimization Day as the climax of the first year's work. Grants, embeds, podcasts, prize pool, celebrity seeding, all feeding the day.
- The [Humanity To-Do List](humanity-todo-list.qmd) publishes a "participation" column that names every assignee who committed to the day and every assignee who did not.
- The [call script](call-script.qmd) gets an additional commitment question in the month leading up to the day: "Will you post on Earth Optimization Day?"
- The [distribution checklist](distribution-checklist.qmd) treats Day 0 as the flush-the-queue date: every queued piece of content goes live.
- The [voter-acquisition grant proposal](../grant-proposal/voter-acquisition-grant.qmd) treats the first Earth Optimization Day as the Year 1 milestone.

The day is the convergence point where every channel aligns at the same moment. Each channel produces value on its own. Aligned on one date, they produce a pulse the system cannot route around. And the pulse is not just noise. The pulse passes a law.
